# Upstream attribution and scope

The official [PufferAI/PufferLib](https://github.com/PufferAI/PufferLib) source (`5.0` reference) was consulted to design a compatible reduced C environment.

`minimal.h` is an inspection/reference excerpt and should not be treated as a complete or byte-identical clone. The official upstream file location is [`ocean/minimal/minimal.h`](https://github.com/PufferAI/PufferLib/blob/5.0/ocean/minimal/minimal.h). The official repository and licensing terms remain authoritative. No upstream Git history is bundled.

`bash scripts/install_in_puffer.sh` performs a real upstream clone on a workstation with network access and installs the authored household header into that checkout.
